en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a rural landscape featuring several houses and farm buildings scattered among fields and trees. The overall style of the buildings and the vastness of the fields suggest a Northern European countryside. The text in the lower left corner includes 'Parti av Stange,' and there is some additional text in the lower right indicating a date and photographer.
